shot_purpose: 先证明高为 1 的等边三角形确实能容纳所有方向，而不是只报面积。
edit_in: 从凸性定义左图转为三角形。
screen_direction: 高度标尺自下而上出现，方向残影围绕中心展开。
mathematical_locks: Convex triangle is only the convex-restricted optimum; equilateral triangle height is 1, side length is 2/sqrt(3), area is 1/sqrt(3).

continuity.in: 从凸性定义左图转为三角形。

reject_if: Must show continuous direction coverage, not just static area
start/key/end frames do not form the stated action chain
camera motion hides the action peak or reverses the declared screen direction
the equilateral triangle is implied to solve the unrestricted non-convex problem
